summary.text: Jonathan Pinson is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates representing District 17 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a pastor and a former police officer.

paragraphs.text: Jonathan Pinson graduated from Ravenswood High School and earned a degree from West Virginia University at Parkersburg.
His career experience includes working as a police officer with the Jackson County Sheriff's Department and as a pastor.
